matrix_a_prior_guidance_and_track_record.metric: Q2 FY27E Revenue vs. Prior Management Guide
matrix_a_prior_guidance_and_track_record.tooltip_title: Comparison of management's Q1 FY27 outlook for Q2 FY27 against Street consensus.
matrix_a_prior_guidance_and_track_record.tooltip_def: Revenue Guidance Calibration: On Sept 1, 2026, management guided Q2 FY27 revenue to $525M–$535M (+96% to +100% YoY, +10.6% QoQ at midpoint). Yahoo consensus sits at $531.95M, slightly above midpoint.
matrix_a_prior_guidance_and_track_record.variance_and_sandbag_commentary: Credo beat top-line consensus in 4 straight quarters, yet Q1's 9.6% QoQ pace cooled from Q3 FY26's +51.9% jump, prompting a -20.04% post-print pullback despite beating EPS.

matrix_a_prior_guidance_and_track_record.tooltip_title: Management's track record delivering 67%–69% Non-GAAP gross margin alongside elevated R&D.
matrix_a_prior_guidance_and_track_record.tooltip_def: Margin Execution: Q1 Non-GAAP GM printed 68.0% even as GAAP R&D surged +118% YoY to $114.52M and SBC hit $87.98M. Q2 Non-GAAP OpEx is guided to $100M–$105M.
matrix_a_prior_guidance_and_track_record.variance_and_sandbag_commentary: Management has consistently outperformed initial gross margin bands by 50–100 bps due to favorable 100G/lane SerDes mix, offsetting DustPhotonics integration costs.

matrix_a_prior_guidance_and_track_record.metric: Non-GAAP Diluted EPS & SBC Dilution Control
matrix_a_prior_guidance_and_track_record.tooltip_title: 4Q Non-GAAP EPS surprise history versus GAAP SBC dilution ($87.98M in Q1 FY27).
matrix_a_prior_guidance_and_track_record.tooltip_def: EPS & SBC Audit: Trailing 4Q EPS surprises were +35.26%, +13.74%, +12.17%, and +2.69% (avg +15.96%), though surprise magnitude compressed as Street caught up and Q1 SBC jumped +77% QoQ to $87.98M.
matrix_a_prior_guidance_and_track_record.variance_and_sandbag_commentary: Surprise compression from +35% to +2.7% over 4 quarters alongside Q1 True FCF dipping to -$5.03M makes Q3 FY27 guidance and SBC moderation critical.

matrix_b_forward_guidance_bogeys.forward_metric: Q3 FY27E Revenue Guide & H2 Optical Re-Acceleration
matrix_b_forward_guidance_bogeys.tooltip_title: Forward Q3 FY27 (Jan 2027 quarter) revenue guidance confirming fiscal H2 re-acceleration.
matrix_b_forward_guidance_bogeys.tooltip_def: Q3 FY27E Guidance Bogey: With Q2 consensus at $531.95M and full-year FY27 growth guided >85% YoY (~$2.47B+ implied), Q3 FY27 needs to accelerate meaningfully above $585M–$600M.
matrix_b_forward_guidance_bogeys.strategic_rationale: After Q1's -20.04% sell-off on sequential deceleration fears, proving an H2 optical + 1.6T AEC inflection is essential to unlock the 152% implied Street PT upside.

matrix_b_forward_guidance_bogeys.forward_metric: 1.6T AEC / DSP Ramp & DustPhotonics SiPho Integration
matrix_b_forward_guidance_bogeys.tooltip_title: Commercial ramp timing for 1.6T Active Electrical Cables, 1.6T Optical DSPs, and Silicon Photonics PICs.
matrix_b_forward_guidance_bogeys.tooltip_def: 1.6T & SiPho Execution: Investors need concrete milestone updates on 1.6T AEC customer qualifications, initial 1.6T DSP orders, and DustPhotonics SiPho PIC scaling beyond Q1's first revenue.
matrix_b_forward_guidance_bogeys.strategic_rationale: Hyperscaler transition from 800G to 1.6T clusters (200G/lane) pits Credo's n-1 legacy-node power/cost edge against Astera Labs (20.5x EV/S) and Broadcom.

matrix_b_forward_guidance_bogeys.strategic_rationale: Rebuilding FCF conversion above $120M/qtr and normalizing SBC below $65M/qtr will silence bears pointing to Q1's -$5.03M True FCF.

section_4b_pre_print_debates.title: Law of Large Numbers Deceleration vs. H2 Optical & 1.6T Re-Acceleration
section_4b_pre_print_debates.consensus_view: Skeptics point out that despite beating Q1 FY27 EPS by +2.69%, CRDO plunged -20.04% on Sept 2 as sequential revenue growth moderated to +9.6% QoQ ($479M vs $437M), questioning whether copper AEC demand is maturing ahead of 1.6T transitions.
section_4b_pre_print_debates.variant_perception: Bulls emphasize that Credo trades at just 10.97x Forward P/E and 12.15x EV/Sales despite +98.5% YoY Q2E revenue growth—less than half Astera Labs' 26.0x Forward P/E—while >$600M FY27 optical revenue (ZeroFlap, SiPho PICs, Optical DSPs) creates a second hyper-growth S-curve in H2.
section_4b_pre_print_debates.call_focus_question: CEO Bill Brennan: With Q1 sequential growth moderating to +9.6% before the guided Q2 acceleration to $530M midpoint, how much visibility do you have into Q3/Q4 1.6T AEC and optical DSP ramps to sustain >85% full-year FY27 growth?

section_4b_pre_print_debates.title: Hyperscaler Concentration & Copper-to-Optics Transition (Scale-Up / Scale-Out)
section_4b_pre_print_debates.consensus_view: Bears warn that Credo remains heavily concentrated across a few US hyperscalers (US shipments were 53.3% of Q1 revenue, down from 71.9% in Q4 FY26) and fear optical interconnects or Co-Packaged Optics (CPO) could encroach on copper AEC reach inside next-gen GPU racks.
section_4b_pre_print_debates.variant_perception: Management's vertical integration—acquiring Hyperlume (microLED optical interconnects) and DustPhotonics (Silicon Photonics PICs), plus launching ZeroFlap optics—positions Credo as architecture-agnostic across both short-reach copper AECs and rack-to-rack optical links, while expanding Neo-Cloud and Malaysia ODM deployments ($74.5M in Q1).
section_4b_pre_print_debates.call_focus_question: CEO Bill Brennan & CFO Dan Fleming: How many >10% hyperscaler customers did Credo serve in Q2, and how should investors model the gross margin mix between maturing 800G AECs, ramping 1.6T DSPs, and newly integrated DustPhotonics SiPho PICs?

section_4b_pre_print_debates.title: Forensic SBC Spike ($87.98M), Inventory Build ($313.05M) & Post-M&A Cash Drawdown
section_4b_pre_print_debates.consensus_view: Forensic analysts flag that Q1 FY27 cash and short-term investments dropped by $679M QoQ (from $1,443.3M to $764.3M) to fund DustPhotonics, while SBC jumped +77% QoQ to $87.98M (pulling True FCF to -$5.03M) and inventory swelled +24.8% QoQ to $313.05M.
section_4b_pre_print_debates.variant_perception: Bullish desks view the $313.05M inventory build as intentional wafer and substrate staging for confirmed H2 hyperscaler AEC/DSP backlog, while $764.26M cash vs $26.20M total debt still leaves a $738.06M net cash fortress with zero liquidity risk.
section_4b_pre_print_debates.call_focus_question: CFO Dan Fleming: Following Q1's $87.98M GAAP SBC surge and $313.05M inventory build, was the SBC jump tied to DustPhotonics/Hyperlume acquisition retention awards, and when do you expect working capital and True FCF to normalize?
